verdict.rationale: Formant documents programmatic surfaces relevant to commanding robots: an Admin API for defining custom commands, predefined robot commands such as return-to-home, and an on-device Agent SDK that receives and responds to commands. It also offers a RealtimeSDK/toolkit for building apps against its APIs and an llms.txt for AI consumption. However, nothing shows an AI agent authenticating with scoped credentials or driving a robot end-to-end through a cloud API, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: scoped/least-privilege API credentials for agents, explicitly documented cloud-API command dispatch to a live robot, machine-readable API spec, hands-on or independent evidence of an agent-driven end-to-end control loop.
